routine_notes: Notation 3/10-15 means 3 sets of 10-15 reps. Decrease the weight if you cannot reach 10 reps; increase it when you can reach 15. Warm up with 80% of your working weight for 5-7 reps. If needed, use a rower, cross-trainer, or treadmill for a few minutes to raise your heart rate, or do jumping jacks, burpees, or squats.

On a mat: place one foot in front and the other behind the opposite hip. Keep the front knee over the toe and the foot on the floor. Open the hip and rear hip flexor.
